assertions.title: Log Harvest - Simulator logs are captured during app launch

steps.observed: App launched successfully in simulator E6186E89-8784-473B-A4E4-66E42693F14E

steps.action: Start log capture using XcodeBuildMCP start_sim_log_cap
Extract logs using xcrun simctl spawn log show
steps.observed: Retrieved 609 lines (113,092 bytes) of log content

assertions.title: Boot Milestone Extraction - Boot milestones are extracted from simulator logs in correct order

steps.observed: Found 5 boot milestones with clear ordering
app_launched milestone confirmed at 2026-03-28T23:49:30.493263+0100 (first log entry)
Milestones verified: app_launched (1) -> first_elf_exec_entered (2) -> first_elf_exec_returned (3) -> second_execve_started (4) -> boot_setup_complete (5)

steps.expected: JSON file with at least 'app_launched' milestone
steps.observed: Created boot_milestones.json with 5 milestones including app_launched

frictions.description: XcodeBuildMCP direct log capture via subsystem filter returned minimal content; using xcrun simctl log show with processImagePath predicate yielded richer logs
frictions.resolution: Fell back to simctl log show command with processImagePath contains 'iSH' predicate for comprehensive log capture

frictions.description: Multiple app launch events appear in logs (two boot sequences with PIDs 50153 and 50175), indicating app may have been relaunched during log capture
frictions.resolution: Both boot sequences captured; milestones extracted from both with ordering verified within each sequence

summary: Tested 2 assertions: 2 passed (VAL-APPSIM-011: Log Harvest, VAL-APPSIM-012: Boot Milestone Extraction). Log file contains 113,092 bytes across 609 lines. Extracted 5 boot milestones with verified ordering including required 'app_launched' milestone.
